concepts.name: Linear combination
concepts.statement: For real vectors v_i, a linear combination is a sum of scalar multiples c_i v_i.
concepts.description: For real vectors v_i, a linear combination is a sum of scalar multiples c_i v_i.

concepts.name: Span
concepts.statement: Span(v_1,...,v_k) contains all their real linear combinations.
concepts.description: Span(v_1,...,v_k) contains all their real linear combinations.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: Span membership
concepts.statement: For real v_i and b: b belongs to their span iff sum c_i v_i=b is solvable.
concepts.description: For real v_i and b: b belongs to their span iff sum c_i v_i=b is solvable.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: Independent family B
concepts.statement: For a finite real vector family B: sum c_i v_i=0 forces every c_i=0.
concepts.description: For a finite real vector family B: sum c_i v_i=0 forces every c_i=0.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: Dependent family
concepts.statement: A real vector family is dependent when a nonzero coefficient tuple gives zero.
concepts.description: A real vector family is dependent when a nonzero coefficient tuple gives zero.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: B spans V
concepts.statement: For a subspace V of R^n and B contained in V: span(B)=V.
concepts.description: For a subspace V of R^n and B contained in V: span(B)=V.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: B is a basis of V
concepts.statement: For a subspace V of R^n and B contained in V: B spans V and is independent.
concepts.description: For a subspace V of R^n and B contained in V: B spans V and is independent.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: Dimension
concepts.statement: Dimension of a real subspace is the cardinality of any basis.
concepts.description: Dimension of a real subspace is the cardinality of any basis.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: Equal basis sizes
concepts.statement: For a subspace V of R^n: every basis of V has the same size.

concepts.name: Column stochastic matrix
concepts.statement: A real square matrix is column stochastic when entries are nonnegative and each column sums to one.
concepts.description: A real square matrix is column stochastic when entries are nonnegative and each column sums to one.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: Positive stochastic matrix
concepts.statement: A positive column stochastic matrix has every entry strictly positive.
concepts.description: A positive column stochastic matrix has every entry strictly positive.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: Steady state
concepts.statement: For a column stochastic A: a steady state is a positive vector x with Ax=x and sum x_i=1.
concepts.description: For a column stochastic A: a steady state is a positive vector x with Ax=x and sum x_i=1.
